proof: A shattered set of size d induces the boundary of a d-dimensional cross-polytope in the Yang complex. Its top reduced homology is nonzero over every field, so Hochster's formula gives $\mathrm{Y}_p(\mathcal H)\geq d$. Maximize over shattered sets.
name: Characteristic-p Yang Dimension / VC Dimension
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n-1$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints. This holds for every fixed prime p.
